svg.aria-label: Deliverable 1, how the parts fit: Hazard registry (78 hazards · 8 layers); stellar-core (its validation code); Corpus entries (what the guide cites); Field table, checklist (generated, with sources); Guide draft v0.9 (one section per layer); xdrproof guide check (fails on a gap, in CI); Expert review (a core or platform engineer); Indexer and SDK teams (read and apply it). Stamp: xdrproof, Deliverable 1, Tranche 1 · due 26 Jan 2027.
